author: ETA PRIME
description:
We are testing the all-new GPD Win Max 3 running the official SteamOS 3.10 main branch. This 9-inch mini laptop transforms into a full gaming handheld by removing the magnetic panels over the built-in controller. Powered by the AMD Ryzen AI Max 388 with 8 cores, 16 threads, and the Radeon 8060S iGPU, the hardware puts down excellent frame rates at both 35W and 65W TDPs. The system features a 9-inch 165Hz OLED display and 64GB of unified memory, allowing up to 26GB of dedicated VRAM for demanding games
